command: Human LPGAT1 has monoacylglycerol acyltransferase capacity, contributes to triacylglycerol biosynthesis or PG/PI remodeling, and acylates 1-acyl-lysophosphatidylserine. Assess each separately with exact donor/acceptor and sn-position definitions. PMID:36049524 calls LPI/LPG poor substrates and reports reduced sn-1 activity in knockout samples; poor is not zero. Compare PMID:15485873, PMID:20018982, PMID:37917582 and PMID:42173283. Does newer predominant positional specificity exclude all older secondary activities, or do construct, assay and organism differences explain them? Distinguish demonstrable intrinsic chemistry from physiological pathway flux and abundance phenotypes.
